propositions: Identical allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) are memoized at the agent-call seam to avoid re-execution and re-paying round-trip costs
Error-prefixed result strings are not memoized and re-execute on retry, while deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' are cached to eliminate duplicate loops
Memoized duplicates receive escalating static nudges (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 thereafter) to steer the model away from redundant calls without breaking prompt-cache stability
The runaway guard's distinct-ratio window continues to observe all duplicate signatures including memoized ones, maintaining the abort backstop at the same pathological threshold
Non-allowlisted tools like record_criterion_verdict and write-bearing functions always execute regardless of prior calls and are never memoized
